mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO quant_strategy_runtime_lease (instance_id, credential_id, symbol, owner_token, lease_epoch, lease_until, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{credentialId}, #{symbol}, #{ownerToken}, 1, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_strategy_runtime_lease SET lease_epoch=CASE WHEN owner_token<>#{ownerToken} OR lease_until<=NOW() THEN lease_epoch+1 ELSE lease_epoch END, instance_id=#{instanceId}, owner_token=#{ownerToken}, lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND (owner_token=#{ownerToken} OR lease_until<NOW())

UPDATE quant_strategy_runtime_lease SET lease_until=DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND), update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND owner_token=#{ownerToken} AND lease_until>NOW()
